summary: Focused testing of the new AI Team Store Wizard (POST /api/wizard/strategy + /tools/team-store-wizard). Backend: 7/7 pytest cases passed (endpoint returns 11 well-formed, personalized sections; validation & error paths correct). Frontend: full 8-step wizard flow completed, 'Generating…' loading state observed, wizard-document rendered with 11 sections, 'AI-generated' badge visible, content correctly personalized with 'Westfield High Boosters'. Restart button also functional.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER wizard_strategy uses it (line 126 references logger, but logger is defined on line 145). Works at runtime because logger is created at module import before any request, but stylistically the logging.basicConfig / getLogger block should be moved to the top of the file for clarity and to avoid a subtle NameError if module ordering ever changes.

server.py wizard_strategy: on LLM failure the endpoint raises HTTPException 502; the frontend has a client-side fallback that builds a local doc. Consider returning the local fallback from the server itself (200 with a flag) so non-JS clients also get value — currently only React fallback catches this.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth required for wizard endpoint
seed_data_creation: None. Endpoint is stateless (no DB writes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard endpoint takes ~15-25s per AI call (Claude sonnet-4-6 via Emergent LLM key). backend_test uses module-scoped fixture to call once. Frontend selectors used: wizard-orgName, wizard-next, wizard-generate, wizard-document, wizard-restart. All work as expected.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Backend endpoint returns proper JSON with ~11 sections; frontend correctly wires loading state, renders document, shows AI badge.
